minecraft:written_book_content.title: Platform Notice
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Station Clerk
pages: {"text":"Service suspended until further notice. No trains are scheduled, and no line is shown beyond the western tunnel."}
{"text":"The timetable has one departure written in fresh ink."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The crypt's oldest stone carries the station mark. The rail map and burial plan use the same impossible measurements."}
